scope: Search of all seven proposed source families; curated additions and a separate full Reactor folder inventory. Not an exhaustive crawl of the public web. Follow-up: official Blackmagic product, support, training, SDK and forum resources checked on 2026-09-06.

additions.creator: heiba
additions.name: DaVinci TTS
additions.access: 📦 Public listing; price/download access not established
additions.description: Generates speech from timeline text or subtitles and imports audio into the Media Pool. Supports Microsoft, MiniMax and OpenAI voices; external provider terms and costs apply. Store price and availability did not render reliably.

additions.creator: heiba
additions.name: DaVinci Image AI
additions.access: 📦 Public listing; price/download access not established
additions.description: Integrates Google Nano Banana image generation and editing into Resolve. Requires an external AI service; store price, edition requirements and availability were not established.

additions.creator: heiba
additions.name: DaVinci Sub Translator
additions.access: 📦 Public listing; price/download access not established
additions.description: Translates subtitle tracks through online translation or LLM services and imports translated subtitles into a timeline track. Provider costs may apply; store availability was not established.

additions.creator: heiba
additions.name: DaVinci Sub Tool (Edit & Translate)
additions.access: 📦 Public listing; price/download access not established
additions.description: Batch subtitle editing, search/replace and online translation. Listed separately from Sub Translator by the creator; overlap or upgrade entitlement is not established. Provider costs may apply.

additions.name: YouTube Prep Tool

additions.access: 🆓 Free beta
additions.description: Beta spectral film-emulation OFX with negative, print and scan stages. Official install instructions require Resolve Studio; possible macOS Free behavior is unconfirmed. Linux packaging information differs between the site and repository instructions.

additions.name: ExponentialGlow
additions.access: 📦 Public Reactor package; check package license
additions.description: Exponential-falloff glow macro designed for linear-gamma floating-point imagery. Author recommends float32 to avoid banding in strong glows.

additions.name: XfChroma Fuse
